## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]

The report rates BULL Neutral/Wait with low-to-moderate confidence at IDR 380, the daily and encoded 20-day low. Aroon, SuperTrend, Vortex, EMA structure, MACD and multi-horizon momentum are bearish. Short RSI/stochastic/Donchian oversold readings and Fisher reversal offer rebound potential. ATR Bullish, rising OBV and ADL conflict with bearish direction; CMF −0.3631, falling MFI and Volume Ratio 20D 0.3744 undermine demand confirmation.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]

For the session-5 close, scenarios are bull IDR 398–404 at 25%, base IDR 378–396 at 40%, and bear IDR 356–376 at 35%. Midpoint-weighted gross expected return is approximately +0.83%. The subjective terminal probabilities do not predict an intrawindow high, target touch or realized trade outcome.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]

The report attributes strong first-half results, fleet expansion and analyst optimism to dated September reporting. It treats Middle East route disruption as potentially favorable to tanker rates while warning that normalization can reverse the benefit. BI/rupiah pressure, Fed tightening, oil costs and shipping insecurity offset the narrative. No company event is confirmed inside the window and disclosure coverage may be incomplete.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]

The conditional watch area is IDR 380–384 after support holds; alternative confirmation is a close above 398 with stronger participation. The indicative closing risk limit is 376, computed from an ambiguously defined 1.04% ATR-stop field. Profit zones are 398–400 and 402–404; an illustrative 382/376/402 structure gives 3.33:1 before costs. The report warns that neither execution nor liquidity is assured.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]

The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, while emphasizing mixed USD revenue/cost and domestic-liquidity effects. It attributes a September 16 Fed increase to higher global rates, financing pressure and weaker emerging-market risk appetite; the company-specific net currency impact is unknown.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]
